about: A filled example of templates/agree/features.json: the locked spec for templates/agree/project-spec.example.md. The request is illustrative; the features are the lab's approval queue (chapter 19), and every proof is a real test in the lab. node tools/features-lock.mjs templates/agree/features.example.json checks it.

features.description: A proposed reply changes nothing until a person approves it, however long it waits.
Closing a ticket needs a lead's approval, and support staff are refused.
A rejection needs a reason, and the assistant reads it on the ticket.
A proposal is decided once, even when two people decide it at the same moment.
An agent given a tool that changes things must name whose approval it needs, and no less than the policy's.
The assistant emails a customer directly when a reply is urgent.
